shortDescription: Chinese flag carrier Air China SSE:601111 on Sunday reported a net loss of 2.3 billion yuan ($341 million) for the first half of 2026, a filing to the Shanghai Stock Exchange showed, widening from a 1.8 billion yuan net loss a year earlier.($1 = 6.7260 Chinese yuan renminbi)
